author: CreeperJoe62
body:
If you have Windows you can check your ping by clicking on the icon at the bottom left, type cmd in the search programs and Windows. After do that do ping [ip] in that spacing. If you have Windows 8 hover over the green bars on the multiplayer screen (often not the most accurate). I'm not sure how to do the cmd thing for Mac so if someone could tell me I'd appreciate it very much :).
I get 400ms regularly (500ms at night).
What ms do you get?
